title: 第一卷 第5章 面红耳赤第一卷 第6章 婉儿怀孕
slug: 老来娶妻的我打造出最强仙族
lines: 翌日清晨。
榻上一片凌乱。
柳婉儿绝美面容上，带着满足笑意，还在酣睡。
乌黑的长发散在枕上，一条白皙修长的细腿，搭在林逸身上。
长睫轻垂，呼吸轻柔，胸口微微起伏。
睡袍的领口微敞，露出一抹雪白。
十九岁的少女，刚为人妻，眉眼间还带着几分稚气，却又添了几分女人的妩媚。
“婉儿睡着的模样，真美！”
林逸侧着头，痴痴看着自己的小娇妻，心里由衷赞叹道。
想起昨夜恩爱，愈发看得入神。
柳婉儿似有所觉，迷迷糊糊睁开眼，看到林逸正盯着自己，顿时羞红了脸。
“夫君，你昨晚太勇猛了！”
“一点都不知道怜香惜玉！”
柳婉儿声音带着刚睡醒的沙哑，软糯糯的，钻进耳朵里，嗔怪道。
“婉儿，我下次一定注意！”
林逸老脸微红，嘿嘿一笑。
他也没想到，这次修为晋升炼气四层，自己竟然这么坚挺持久。
“我现在都还觉得浑身都跟散架了一样，哪里都疼！”
柳婉儿钻进林逸怀里，撒娇道。
忽然，她灵机一动。
“夫君，要不你将红菱姐也娶了吧！”
“她年芳四十，修为炼气二层，风韵犹存！”
柳婉儿嘻嘻一笑，很是俏皮可爱。
“别乱说！”
“红菱知道了会生气的！”
林逸连连摆手道。
其实，他也很想这么做。
将红菱娶过来，洞房后，本命仙族灵树，立马就能结出一枚仙灵果，大幅提升他的实力。
“夫君，你不试试怎么知道呢？”
“说不定，红菱姐对你也有想法，就等着你开口呢！”
柳婉儿轻轻刮了下林逸的鼻子，笑着怂恿道。
听到这话。
林逸不由心里一动。
等回头，他要不旁敲侧击，试探下阮红菱的想法？
目前来说。
唯一有希望被他拿下，愿意嫁给他，而且不会吃他绝户的女子，也就只有阮红菱了。
牙行的颜如玉，醉仙坊的曲嫣然，隔壁王开山的女儿王雨馨，都是拿他打趣，不太可能嫁给他这老汉。
“回头找机会，我问问红菱！”
林逸下定决心道。
随即，他看着慵懒的柳婉儿，满脸宠溺。
“婉儿，我去做早饭，你起来洗漱一番！”
“等会我就送你去云梦城的醉仙坊，学习酿制灵酒！”
林逸在柳婉儿浑圆柔软的翘臀上轻拍两下，笑着招呼道。
content_en:
The next morning.
The bed was in a mess.
Liu Waner's beautiful face showed a satisfied smile, and she was still sleeping soundly.
Her long black hair was scattered on the pillow, and a pair of fair and slender legs rested on Lin Yi.
Her long eyelashes droop lightly, her breathing is gentle, and her chest rises and falls slightly.
The neckline of the nightgown was slightly open, revealing a hint of white.
The nineteen-year-old girl has just become a wife. She still has a bit of childishness in her eyebrows, but she also has a bit of feminine charm.
"Wan'er's sleeping look is so beautiful!"
Lin Yi tilted his head and looked at his little wife, admiring from the bottom of his heart.
Thinking of the love last night, I became even more fascinated.
Liu Wan'er seemed to be aware of it, and opened her eyes in a daze. When she saw Lin Yi staring at her, she suddenly blushed with embarrassment.
"Husband, you were so brave last night!"
"I don't know how to pity the beauty and cherish the jade at all!"
Liu Wan'er's voice was hoarse and soft as if she had just woken up from sleep, and it penetrated into her ears, complaining.
"Wan'er, I will definitely pay attention next time!"
Lin Yi's face turned red and he smiled.
He also didn't expect that after being promoted to the fourth level of Qi Refining this time, he would be so strong and durable.
"I still feel like my whole body is falling apart, and everything hurts!"
Liu Waner got into Lin Yi's arms and said coquettishly.
Suddenly, she had an idea.
"Husband, why don't you marry Sister Hongling too!"
"She is forty years old, has cultivated to the second level of Qi Refining, and her charm is still there!"
Liu Waner smiled, very playful and cute.
"Stop talking nonsense!"
"Hongling will be angry if he finds out!"
Lin Yi waved his hands repeatedly.
In fact, he also wanted to do this.
After marrying Hong Ling, the natal fairy tree will immediately produce a fairy fruit after the bridal chamber, which will greatly increase his strength.
"Husband, how will you know if you don't try?"
"Maybe Sister Hongling also has ideas for you, and she's just waiting for you to speak!"
Liu Waner gently scraped Lin Yi's nose and encouraged with a smile.
Hear this.
Lin Yi couldn't help but feel moved in his heart.
When he turned back, why didn't he make some insinuations and test Ruan Hongling's thoughts?
For now.
The only woman who has a hope of being captured by him, who is willing to marry him, and who won't kill him is Ruan Hongling.
Yan Ruyu from the tooth shop, Qu Yanran from Zuixianfang, and Wang Yuxin, Wang Kaishan's daughter next door, all made fun of him and were unlikely to marry an old man like him.
"Looking for an opportunity later, I'll ask Hongling!"
Lin Yi made up his mind.
Immediately, he looked at the lazy Liu Wan'er, his face full of doting.
"Wan'er, I'm going to make breakfast, you get up and wash up!"
"I will send you to Zuixianfang in Yunmeng City later to learn how to brew spiritual wine!"
Lin Yi patted Liu Wan'er's round and soft buttocks twice and greeted with a smile.
